subject: general
question:
DIRECTIONS: In the sentence find out whether there is any grammatical error in it. The error, if any will be in one part of the sentence. The letter of that part is the answer.

If I will have the time, I shall try and make it to the temple this evening to offer prayers for peace and prosperity of my family

options.text: If I will have the time
I shall try and make it
To the temple this evening to offer prayers
For peace and prosperity of my family

solution:
The correct answer is **If I will have the time**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• The sentence is an example of the **Future Real Conditional clause.**
 
• In &
